(() => { const r = document.activeElement.getBoundingClientRect(); return 'TAB2 ' + document.activeElement.textContent.slice(0,30) + ' top=' + Math.round(r.top) + ' coveredByHeader=' + (r.top < 64); })()

(() => { const r = document.querySelector('.stage-art').getBoundingClientRect(); return 'FULL ' + document.querySelector('.figure-panel').dataset.full + ' art=' + Math.round(r.width) + 'x' + Math.round(r.height) + ' focus=' + document.activeElement.getAttribute('aria-label'); })()

(() => { const r = document.querySelector('.stage-art').getBoundingClientRect(); return 'EXIT focus=' + document.activeElement.getAttribute('aria-label') + ' art=' + Math.round(r.left) + ',' + Math.round(r.top) + ' ' + Math.round(r.width) + 'x' + Math.round(r.height); })()
